_comment: Property identifiers only. No secrets. The service account key lives at ~/.config/brightbox/service-account.json and is never stored in this repository.
_gsc_note: gsc_site_url is auto-detected on first run and written back here. Search Console properties are either 'sc-domain:brightboxdigital.io' or 'https://brightboxdigital.io/' depending on how the property was verified.
